subject.title: feat(gateway): add configurable Control UI title

question: Should OpenClaw accept a new static `gateway.controlUi.title` config key, and should it take precedence over dynamic session-derived browser titles?
rationale: This is a new strict operator config surface with rollback impact and it overlaps the active dynamic browser-title proposal, so automation should not choose the permanent product policy alone.

options.title: Accept Static Title Config
options.body: Land a refreshed version with docs and make configured static titles the highest-precedence browser title.

options.title: Prefer Dynamic Titles
options.body: Pause or close this static config path and keep browser-title policy on the session/agent-derived proposal.

options.title: Defer Title Policy
options.body: Keep the PR open without repair until maintainers settle static and dynamic title precedence together.

recommendation.title: Accept Static Title Config
recommendation.body: Land a refreshed version with docs and make configured static titles the highest-precedence browser title.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision centers on the Gateway Control UI bootstrap contract and browser-title policy, where this history is strongest.
